proxies: SPY QQQ IWM SMH IGV XBI JNK TLT ^VIX ^TNX BZ=F NQ=F ES=F
scope: Purposive liquid/high-attention US-listed survivors; not the whole market and not historical point-in-time membership
features: Completed daily price-volume and market variables, no future-open inputs; current fundamental/event review kept separate

targets.hit5: next regular-session high / next regular-session open - 1 >= 5%
targets.hit10: next regular-session high / next regular-session open - 1 >= 10%

not_target: High versus prior close is reported only as gap-including diagnostic. No historical after-hours fills available: do not call next-open predictions after-hours trade probabilities. High touch does not guarantee realized profit and may occur after a stop loss.
evaluation: 2025 through latest mature outcome; retrospective temporal evaluation, not virgin untouched holdout
model_a: Standardized ridge logistic, penalty .01, features clipped at 8 train standard deviations; Platt calibration on 2023-2024
model_b: Fixed nonlinear ridge logistic, penalty .03; base features plus squared standardized features and fixed interactions: ret1*volume_ratio, range_position*volume_ratio, ret1*QQQ_r1, atr_pct*VIX_level, ret20*rs20. Platt calibration on 2023-2024.
ensemble: Equal average calibrated probabilities; no best-model cherry-pick
liquidity_filter: Signal close >=5 USD and prior20 average traded dollar volume >=50m USD
selection: Rank by ensemble hit5; report hit10, close3 and down3 jointly. Event/financial quality and current after-hours entry premium independently reviewed, not forged into probability. Compare historical daily top1 to same-day pool baseline and fixed volatility ranking.
confidence: Calibration bins and chronological daily top1 hit rate; 5-session date-block bootstrap for selected event hit rate and close-to-open net return. 95% confidence interval is historical frequency uncertainty, not confidence of any one forecast.
entry_overlay: Current after-hours quote with timestamp; no live spread or overnight venue access assumed; no chasing >1% above quoted reference or >0.2 ATR without fresh reassessment. Trading plans are analyst overlay, not model-tested fill strategy.
limitations: no market depth/borrow-cost/overnight broker quote feed
implementation_note: sklearn unavailable in local runtime; model B changed to explicit nonlinear logistic before any model outcomes were computed. Both models are related estimators, not independent evidence.
correctness_revision: Before publication, numerical audit required damped Newton with logaddexp line search and convergence checks; BZ futures return shifted one full vendor session to avoid an unfinished current day; ineligible names remain diagnostic only.
